checks: Hold actual STATUS_PENDING before Request AsyncId publication; emit one sync CANCEL; then release pending.
Cancel the second watch after real AsyncId publication.
Race eight callers on a third watch; exactly one cancel succeeds and one serialized CANCEL is observed.
Repeated cancel returns false; cancelled get throws CancellationException.
Fourth watch completes with event.bin after native file creation; completed cancel returns false.
Each final response removes its MID from the owning Connection outstanding-request table.
All requests/interims/finals pair by native MID; async CANCEL/final reuse the actual pending AsyncId.
CANCEL occupies the original request MID; subsequent watch consumes the next native range after CreditCharge.
Independent JCE GMAC over exact copied serialized/received bytes verifies all signed inputs; prescribed nonce assembled independently.
Each CANCEL rejects verification with the original request nonce (CANCEL bit absent).
All 11 signed inputs in each profile use distinct nonces under that profile actual session/channel key.
Sender direction comes from the serializer/receiver boundary; header SERVER_TO_REDIR must agree before deriving the oracle nonce.
